name: Komodo’s Bite (Combat, Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kineticist 1, acid blast, bite attack.

Benefit(s): Your bite attacks deal 1 point of acid damage in addition to their normal damage. Living creatures you bite must succeed a Fortitude save (DC equal to your acid blast’s DC) or be sickened for a number of rounds equal to 1 + your Con modifier (minimum 1 round). This is a poison effect.
